title: Founding Creative Director
descriptionHtml:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena is about to launch several products in quick succession, and we're not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We're looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who can't look at a landing page without having an opinion, who'd rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.

This is a craft title, not a headcount title. You'll ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after, building toward a small internal agency (two to three people across design, motion, and content) that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.

What You'll Do

  • Own narrative and positioning across every launch. Design as strategy, not decoration

  • Own every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social

  • Own the design system, from v3 onward

  • Set the bar, full stop. If it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • Taste, above everything, with specific, defended opinions about what's good and why

  • A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it. Agency or in-house, brand refresh or full launch, you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes

  • AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste. You've already built something with AI (an app, a prototype, a mockup) and want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti-AI is disqualifying

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • Narrative thinking: you already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look

  • Range that travels. Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial: what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new

  • A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it. Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Experience building or scaling a small internal creative team

  • Motion or video production skills alongside visual design

  • Direct, founder-facing creative leadership experience at another startup

Not a Fit If:

  • You need a creative director above you setting the vision, or a team to delegate to on day one

  • Your best work happens on a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace

  • Too much scrutiny too fast doesn't sound exciting, it sounds exhausting

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Founding EMEA Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We're hiring our first dedicated marketer in EMEA. You'll shape how Listen shows up in Europe and build the demand engine behind it as we scale across the UK, Nordics, DACH France, and beyond.

This is a founding role. You'll be our first marketing hire outside the US, working alongside our rapidly growing EMEA GTM and Post-sale teams to grow the accounts we have and land the next sets. The dominant motion in year one is field and demand: conferences, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and targeted campaigns.

You'll pick the rooms, build the programs that fill them, coordinate the follow-up, and wire it all up so we know what's working by the end of each quarter. This is a senior IC role with real ownership.

Min. 4 years in B2B SaaS marketing with real demand gen or field experience, ideally both. Knowledge of enterprise sales cycles required. Hands-on with marketing systems required. Having built a regional or category motion from an early stage is a strong plus.


Background - GTM

Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.

Company highlights:

  • World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs, former co-founders, and talent from Jane Street, Twitter, Stripe, Rippling, Affirm, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and many more, plus IOI/ICPC backgrounds.

  • Hypergrowth: We're a 90-person team backed by Sequoia, growing from $0 to mid $XXM run-rate in under a year. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and love working with people who take ownership.

  • Europe is already working: Several of the world's largest brands run their global research programs on Listen, including across their European teams. EMEA is where we’ll put dedicated weight behind demand that's already there.

What You'll Do

  • Sharpen Listen's story for European buyers. We hold the enterprise certifications and data residency commitments this market expects. Your job is making sure that part of the pitch lands.

  • Bring the best US programs to the region, and have the judgment to know which ones don't translate.

  • Own the field calendar end to end. Which conferences we show up at, what we do there, and the executive dinners and roundtables that put our European customers in a room with our best prospects.

  • Run the demand programs around that calendar. Account-based campaigns against named targets, webinars, email nurture, and the follow-up in the four weeks after every event. Partner with our growth team on EMEA-specific paid campaigns

  • Create the content and brand moments that carry Listen in-region. Localized case studies, launch videos, blog and newsletter content, founder LinkedIn content, and scrappy brand stunts like a first EMEA OOH campaign.

  • Build out the regional engine on top of our existing GTM stack. Segmentation, lists, routing, follow-up sequences, attribution, and a dashboard that tells you and the sales team the truth.

  • Build Listen's community in EMEA, bringing European researchers, insights and marketing leaders together around Listen.

Who You Are

  • You've worked inside a B2B marketing engine and understand how the parts connect. You can look at a funnel and say where it's leaking.

  • You want the version of this job where you build the region and put your name on it.

  • You're hands-on with the systems. CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, attribution. You build the campaign yourself rather than waiting for ops.

  • You're proactive to the point of impatience. You see the gap and start closing it before anyone assigns it.

  • You can create as well as operate. Comfortable writing content and shaping brand moments, and fluent enough in paid to steer it with the growth team

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You're excited to build the European presence of one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

  • You've been the first marketer in a region before, or you've seen it done and know what you'd do differently.

  • You want to set the regional strategy rather than execute a calendar someone else built.

Life at Listen

  • Health, covered: Full medical, dental, and vision. FSA/HSA and life insurance are available too.

  • Competitive compensation: Backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, Ribbit Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC — we hire the best and treat them accordingly, with meaningful equity ownership.

  • Annual Learning Stipend: Books, courses, conferences, coaching, language lessons — almost anything that makes you sharper.

  • Annual Wellness Stipend for your health and headspace: Gym memberships, race fees, massages, ergonomic gear, and more.

  • Monthly Stipend for AI tools: A dedicated budget for the software and GPU credits that make you faster.

  • Fed, daily: A private chef serves lunch and dinner in our SF office; NYC and London teams get daily meal credit.

  • Flexible time off: A take-what-you-need vacation policy.

  • We celebrate together: Company offsites (Hawaii this Summer!) and events like our annual holiday party — every win is a team win.

  • Room to grow: As an early member of the team, you'll own end-to-end processes from scratch and grow alongside the company.

You are the global custodian of how Jellyfish architects, engineers, automates, and commercialises programmatic activation across DSPs, SSPs, curation layers, bidding algorithms, and data clean rooms.

This is a senior role, there is no direct line management or people management but you are expected to collaborate with activation team leads & regional media leadership to affect positive change for Jellyfish clients. You are not running campaign ops or managing direct reports; you are the agency’s most senior programmatic technologist and systems architect. You define the global practice, codify frameworks for scaled delivery, contribute to our proprietary product roadmap, lead high-stakes pitches to win new business, drive technical advancement through strategic ad-tech partnerships, and serve as principal technical counsel to our highest-value global enterprise clients.

You partner closely with regional media and delivery leads across NA, EMEA, and APAC. While regional delivery teams execute programmatic campaigns in their local markets, you set the technical architecture, bidding methodologies, automation workflows, and delivery standards they operate from.

 

50% Product, Commercial & Technical Partnerships · 50% Client Strategic & Technical Leadership

The role is an intentional 50/50 split:

  • 50% Practice & Product Architecture: Designing buying & audience strategies, automation hooks/MCP integration, steering ad-tech integration roadmaps, managing top-tier tech partnerships (Google, The Trade Desk, Amazon, etc.), and spearheading major pitches.

  • 50% Client Strategic Leadership: Serving as principal programmatic strategist and trusted technical advisor for Tier-1 accounts, driving technical maturity (signal resilience, clean rooms, custom algorithms) and unlocking incremental retained revenue.

     

Your primary responsibilities will include:

 

1. Product Strategy, Automation & Technical Partnerships (50%)

  • Define the Global Programmatic Methodology: Own and update the global programmatic playbook, codifying standards across audience intelligence, bidding, algorithmic optimisation, curated marketplaces (PMPs/PG), dynamic creative optimisation (DCO), and identity/signal resilience.

  • Codify Delivery & Drive Automation: triage execution into fully automated, hybrid, or human-assisted workflows, handing off artefacts to delivery and MSP teams to streamline campaign build times and eliminate operational friction.

  • Contribute to Proprietary Product Evolution: Partner directly with Jellyfish Product teams to feed technical requirements, data schemas, and API automation hooks into internal tooling.

  • Ad-Tech Partnerships & Frontier Innovation: Own strategic technical relationships with core platforms (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon, Google, premium SSPs, retail ad networks, clean rooms). Secure first-mover advantage on platform alphas and betas, testing them technically and translating them into deployable client solutions.

  • Product-Centric New Business: Architect winning product narratives, bespoke tech architectures, and commercial frameworks for major pitches and RFPs. Lead the programmatic discipline in tier-1 global pitches, driving high pitch-win rates and expanding retained scope.

  • Cross-Discipline Integration: Architect the connective programmatic layer across Search, Social, Retail Media, GEO, and Creative, building unified full-funnel activation frameworks (e.g., audience syncing, cross-channel frequency management, closed-loop attribution).

2. Client Strategic & Technical Leadership (50%)

  • Principal Technical Counsel for Tier-1 Clients: Act as the lead advisor for CMOs, Heads of Media, and MarTech executives at enterprise accounts - translating complex programmatic engineering into board-level growth strategies.

  • Drive Client Programmatic & AI Maturity: Actively advance Tier-1 clients along the programmatic maturity curve.

  • Brief Validation & Technical Governance: Serve as the technical filter on complex client briefs, ensuring brief feasibility and alignment with modern media architectures before execution.

  • Thought Leadership & External Voice: Represent Jellyfish as a category authority through POVs, white papers, analyst briefings, industry summits, and keynotes on topics like cookieless addressability, agentic media buying, and AI-driven curation.

     

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of advanced programmatic and ad-tech experience within an agency, DSP/SSP, ad-tech vendor, or sophisticated brand-side media team.

  • Expert Technical Proficiency across Enterprise DSPs: Deep technical fluency with platforms such as Display & Video 360 (DV360), The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Campaign Manager 360, and major SSP curation tools.

  • Supply Path & Media Economics: Strong track record designing SPO frameworks, private marketplace (PMP) deal structures, and custom algorithm setups.

  • Track Record in Commercial Growth: Proven background contributing to high-value new business pitches, RFPs, and expanding programmatic scope in enterprise brand accounts.

  • No line-management required, but proven leadership through influence, upskilling, and technical mentorship across cross-functional teams.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. You'll build and lead Omnea's DACH business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in DACH.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! descriptionHtml:

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

title: Growth Partnerships Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Zable is about to become the face of Lendable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

title: GTM Engineering Intern | Revenue Operations (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline.

🌀 Build signals and tooling

  • Ship signals. Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers.

  • Process scaling. Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks.

⚙️ Build automations

  • Remove manual work. Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day.

  • Challenge what exists. Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them.

💶 Unblock the sales team

  • Understand what sales reps need. Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing.

🗂 Own the data

  • Own enrichment and imports. Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level.

  • Keep data accuracy high. You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing.

Your Toolkit

You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more.

Work location

Our Munich headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is hybrid, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Whom you will be working with

  • Max Hungenbach, Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager

  • Danny Bodnar, GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy.

  • Dasha Vyazemskaya, Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team

  • George Knight, Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing

  • Our Account Executives and BDRs across Europe and North America, for whom your campaigns run

Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Head of Exchange Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

  • Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

  • Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

  • Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

  • Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

  • Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

  • Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

  • Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

  • Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 

What you bring

  • Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

  • Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

  • Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

  • Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

  • Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

  • Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

  • Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 

Nice to haves

  • Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

  • Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

  • Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

  • Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

   

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs - AI and P2P (100% remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

  • Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance: Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

  • Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership: Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

  • Regulatory Strategy Development: As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

  • Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

  • Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.


  • Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

  • Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

  • Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

  • Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

  • Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

title: Head of Sales SaaS
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS BtoB dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des ETI & grands comptes.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (PRIVACY, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

Dans un contexte de croissance et de structuration de notre organisation commerciale, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Sales Manager pour accompagner et faire grandir notre équipe Sales.


Tu prendras dans un premier temps la responsabilité de notre équipe New Business France, composée de 6 Account Executives, avec un périmètre amené à évoluer progressivement.


Ta mission : piloter la performance collective, faire progresser l’équipe et l’accompagner sur les ventes B2B SaaS les plus complexes.


Nous recherchons avant tout un manager très opérationnel et proche du terrain : quelqu’un qui aime coacher, challenger, transmettre ses méthodes et s’impliquer directement sur les deals stratégiques.

Tu porteras les objectifs collectifs de l’équipe, sans objectif individuel de vente.

Manager & faire progresser l’équipe

  • Manager et coacher une super équipe Sales AE au quotidien

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux différents profils et niveaux d’autonomie

  • Faire monter l’équipe en compétences sur les méthodes et techniques de vente

  • Installer le bon niveau de rythme, d’exigence et de culture de la performance

  • Être présent sur le terrain et accompagner les Sales sur les moments clés du cycle de vente

Piloter la performance commerciale

  • Déployer une stratégie de croissance ambitieuse

  • Porter l’objectif d’ARR collectif de l’équipe

  • Piloter le pipe, de la création au suivi

  • Être responsable du forecast et de sa fiabilité

  • Suivre et analyser les KPIs commerciaux (Volume d'activités, panier moyen, win rate...)

  • Identifier les leviers d’amélioration et contribuer à optimiser la performance commerciale de l’équipe

Accompagner les deals complexes

  • Challenger les stratégies de vente et de closing,

  • Accompagner l’équipe sur les deals stratégiques, ventes multi-interlocuteurs et appels d’offres,

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques commerciales,

  • Apporter son expertise et son soutien à l’équipe dans les situations complexes.

Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec notre CRO sur la stratégie commerciale et le développement de l’activité. Tu seras également attendu comme force de proposition, capable de challenger l’existant et de contribuer à faire évoluer notre organisation Sales.

Le profil recherché

  • Tu as une expérience solide en vente complexe B2B SaaS, notamment auprès d’ETI et/ou Grands Comptes

  • Tu as démontré de très bonnes performances commerciales, que tu sais expliquer à travers des KPIs précis

  • Tu as déjà une première expérience réussie en management ou team leadership (minimum 5 personnes)

  • Tu as l’habitude des cycles de vente complexes, impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs

  • Tu as déjà participé à des appels d’offres

  • Tu es à l’aise en anglais (niveau C2)

  • Une expérience dans la cybersécurité, la Privacy, la Compliance ou la gouvernance des données sera un vrai plus

Au-delà du parcours, nous cherchons surtout quelqu’un qui aime faire gagner une équipe : un profil énergique, exigeant et orienté résultats, avec un vrai goût pour le coaching et la transmission.

Tu sais prendre de la hauteur tout en restant très terrain. Tu es à l’écoute, humble, collectif et capable de challenger avec des arguments.

Pourquoi rejoindre Dastra ?

  • Prendre la responsabilité opérationnelle de la performance de notre équipe Sales France

  • Avoir un rôle de manager réellement hands-on, au contact des équipes et des deals

  • Participer activement à la structuration et à l’évolution de notre organisation commerciale

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Fünf Praxen, ein Auftrag: Du verantwortest die Technik und baust Software, die unseren Teams Zeit zurückgibt. KU64 ist inhabergeführt, ohne Investoren und ohne Kette. Über 40 Zahnärztinnen und Zahnärzte arbeiten in fünf Praxen in Berlin und Potsdam, jeden Monat kommen über 1.000 neue Patientinnen und Patienten dazu.

Du verbindest IT-Betrieb und eigene Softwareentwicklung für alle fünf Standorte und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Dabei arbeitest du mit den Praxisteams und unseren IT-Partnern zusammen, klärst Zuständigkeiten und entscheidest, was zuerst besser werden muss.

Das verantwortest du

  • Betrieb an fünf Standorten: Netz, Server, Arbeitsplätze, Telefonie und Telematikinfrastruktur. Du sorgst für einen Betrieb, auf den sich jedes Team verlassen kann, und dafür, dass Wissen nicht nur in Köpfen steckt.
  • Praxissoftware und Geräte: CGM Z1 Pro ist das Herz des Praxistags. Dazu digitales Röntgen, DVT, Intraoralscanner und CAD/CAM. Du koordinierst ihre Anbindung mit Teams, Herstellern und Partnern.
  • Sicherheit und Datenschutz: Gesundheitsdaten verdienen Sorgfalt: Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor, Auftragsverarbeitung, Schulung. Und eine Wiederherstellung, die du geprobt hast.
  • Partner und Budget: Du steuerst Dienstleister für Hardware, Telefonie und Gerätewartung, prüfst Verträge und machst Kosten und Prioritäten nachvollziehbar.
  • Eigene Software und Agenten: Wir entwickeln unsere interne Software selbst, und sie wächst unter dir weiter. Du prüfst, wo KI-Agenten im Praxisalltag wirklich helfen, erprobst sie mit dem Team und bringst in den Betrieb, was sich bewährt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • In der Praxis: CGM Z1 Pro, Doctolib, Personio, Telematikinfrastruktur
  • Bildgebung und Geräte: DVT und digitales Röntgen, Intraoralscanner, CAD/CAM
  • Infrastruktur: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows Server, UniFi, Azure geplant
  • Eigene Entwicklung: TypeScript, Cloud-Dienste, APIs und Schnittstellen, Sprachmodelle

Du musst nicht alles davon kennen.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • 30 Tage, Verstehen: Du lernst Teams, Systeme und Verträge kennen und hältst fest, wo der Betrieb zuerst Aufmerksamkeit braucht.
  • 60 Tage, Ordnen: Zuständigkeiten sind geklärt, die wichtigsten Verbesserungen laufen. Mit einem Team wählst du den ersten Anwendungsfall für einen Agenten.
  • 90 Tage, Erproben: Deine Roadmap für die nächsten zwölf Monate liegt auf dem Tisch. Eine erste Lösung läuft im Praxisalltag, mit einem Menschen an ihrer Seite.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast IT-Betrieb verantwortet: Für Systeme, Dienstleister und die Menschen, die damit arbeiten. Nicht nur für Code.
  • Du entwickelst selbst: TypeScript, APIs und Cloud-Dienste. Du bringst Software zuverlässig in den Betrieb und hältst sie dort.
  • Du nimmst Menschen mit: Du setzt Prioritäten und erklärst Technik so, dass ein Praxisteam sie gern benutzt. Deutsch fließend.

Ein Plus

  • KI-Agenten oder Sprachmodelle im echten Einsatz
  • CGM Z1 oder andere Praxis- und Kliniksoftware
  • Telematikinfrastruktur, Röntgen und Medizingeräte im Netz
  • Entra ID, Intune, Azure und UniFi

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Rolle, die es noch nicht gab: Du baust sie auf und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung.
  • Wirkung, die man sieht: Was du baust, benutzen fünf Praxisteams am nächsten Morgen.
  • Mittagessen im Haus: Unser Mitarbeiterrestaurant am Ku'damm.
  • Büro am Kurfürstendamm 64: Mitten in der City West, mit dem Team im selben Haus.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Bewerben: Ohne Anschreiben. Lebenslauf hochladen, fünf kurze Fragen beantworten und ein Beispiel aus deiner Arbeit beschreiben.
  2. Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung: Am Ku'damm oder per Video. Wir reden über Systeme, die du verantwortet hast, und über das, was dich an der Rolle reizt.
  3. Ein Nachmittag im Haus: Du siehst Empfang, Behandlungszimmer und Technik und sprichst mit dem Team.
  4. Angebot: Wenn es passt, besprechen wir Gehalt und Starttermin.

title: HR stagiair Learning & Development (meewerkstage)
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij tijdens je stage echt meedraaien en ontdekken hoe leren en ontwikkelen werkt in de praktijk? Bij DPD Nederland in Oirschot krijg je als HR stagiair Learning & Development de kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een professioneel én toegankelijk L&D‑team. Je werkt samen met ervaren specialisten en leert hoe trainingen en e‑learning bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van medewerkers.
Lees verder en ontdek of deze stage bij jou past.

Wat ga je doen?

Je komt in het Learning & Development team van DPD Nederland. Dit team bestaat uit de Manager Talent Acquisition & Development en twee Learning & Development specialisten en is onderdeel van afdeling HR, waar ruim 20 collega’s werken.
Je krijgt goede begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en leert vooral door te doen. Geen stagedag is hetzelfde.

Dit ga je leren en doen:

  • Meewerken met het leermanagementsysteem (LMS), zoals het bouwen en verbeteren van online cursussen.

  • Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van leerprogramma’s en trainingen.

  • Meedenken over creatieve en vernieuwende manieren van leren, online én offline.

  • Helpen bij het inventariseren van leerbehoeften van medewerkers.

  • Assisteren bij de organisatie van workshops, trainingen en e‑learningmodules.

  • Leren hoe DPD investeert in persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450 tot €550 bruto per maand.

  • Een meewerkstage van 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Intensieve en persoonlijke begeleiding door ervaren L&D‑specialisten.

  • Onbeperkt toegang tot ons leerplatform en deelname aan DPD Inspires.

  • Veel ruimte om te leren, vragen te stellen en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

  • Vrijheid om mee te denken en (waar mogelijk) eigen ideeën uit te werken.

  • Een leerzame stage binnen een professionele, maar toegankelijke werkomgeving.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Je volgt een Hbo- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Learning & Development, HRM, opleidingskunde, onderwijskunde of (bedrijfs- of toegepaste)psychologie.

  • Interesse in leren, ontwikkelen en persoonlijke groei.

  • Een leergierige, proactieve houding.

  • Je kunt goed plannen en houdt overzicht.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en durft vragen te stellen.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en wilt graag nieuwe dingen leren.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Garda Capital Partners (Garda) is a multi-billion dollar alternative investment firm with over 22 years of experience deploying relative value strategies across fixed income markets for institutional investors. We hire, grow, and mentor great talent and remain steadfast in our commitment to building a culture that helps them succeed. Garda is more than a workplace. We are built on trust, integrity, and a shared vision for how we work together, the enduring relationships we build, and the consistency of our results. Garda's primary offices are located in Wayzata, New York City, West Palm Beach, Geneva, Zug, Copenhagen, Singapore, and Scottsdale. 

Garda is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to own Platform Engineering & Automation. This hands-on role builds and operates shared deployment capabilities for infrastructure and selected applications, while providing advanced infrastructure engineering and production support.

The engineer develops reusable deployment pipelines, infrastructure templates, and self-service workflows that help teams provision environments and release changes consistently — working with architecture, application owners, and regional teams to improve platform reliability and resolve complex infrastructure problems.

Position Responsibilities

Escalation & Infrastructure Support

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and recurring operational problems
  • Troubleshoot across Windows/Linux systems, identity, networking, cloud, virtualization, storage, and backup
  • Lead root-cause analysis and convert recurring incidents into engineering work or documented standards
  • Participate in major changes, recovery events, and follow-the-sun handoffs

Platform Engineering & Deployment Automation

  • Build automation using PowerShell, Python, and APIs with production-quality testing and error handling
  • Own reusable infrastructure-as-code and configuration templates (Terraform, Ansible)
  • Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications, including validation, environment promotion, health checks, and rollback
  • Apply Git, peer review, automated tests, change controls, and secure secrets handling

Observability, Reliability & Standards

  • Improve monitoring, logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and automated health checks
  • Tune operational signals to reduce noise and improve detection/recovery
  • Maintain reusable provisioning workflows and self-service capabilities
  • Own platform reliability and lifecycle improvements with service owners

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and workplace technology staff in troubleshooting and automation practices
  • Review infrastructure code and pipeline designs with architecture, Security, and application owners
  • Maintain runbooks, diagrams, and onboarding guidance
  • Maintain a prioritized platform backlog with the architect and regional leads

Qualifications & Desired Skills

  • 4–6 years of hands-on infrastructure operations experience across several domains
  • Degree in IT, computer science, computer engineering, or a related field
  • Advanced PowerShell or Python automation experience, including API integration
  • Practical experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management
  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines (Git, testing, secure deployment, rollback)
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and incident-response skills
  • Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability concepts
  • Ability to document work, mentor others, and collaborate across a distributed team

Preference for experience with:

  • AWS, container platforms, modern cloud operating patterns (Azure a plus)
  • Experience delivering reusable provisioning workflows for infrastructure and business applications
  • Familiarity with ITSM, change, incident, and problem-management practices
  • Experience in financial services or another performance-sensitive environment
  • Track record of solving complex infrastructure problems and building shared capabilities other teams can use independently
  • Strong track record of maintaining high standards for reliability, documentation, and maintainability
  • Experience remaining effective under pressure, with a history of mentoring and knowledge-sharing within teams

title: Ingénieur en Investigation Numérique & Développement Informatique (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences techniques au service de la Justice, contribuer à la résolution d’enquêtes et à la manifestation de la vérité ?

Vous aimez relever des défis technologiques dans un environnement exigeant, où rigueur, précision et innovation donnent tout leur sens à votre travail ?

Alors rejoignez notre équipe et mettez vos talents au service d’une mission qui a du sens !

Qui sommes-nous ?

Le LERTI est un laboratoire privé spécialisé dans l’analyse de données numériques dans un cadre judiciaire, et reconnu au niveau national.

Nous intervenons en qualité d’experts judiciaires, principalement sur des affaires pénales complexes, pour le compte de juges d’instruction et de forces de l’ordre.

Notre mission : extraire, analyser, comprendre et contextualiser des éléments numériques susceptibles de constituer des preuves dans le cadre d’enquêtes et de procédures pénales.

Votre mission

Vous aurez pour mission d’extraire les données de téléphones, ordinateurs et autres supports numériques, puis de les rendre exploitables par les analystes, tout en contribuant au développement d’outils informatiques facilitant leur travail.

Vos responsabilités principales

Faire parler les données numériques

  • Explorer smartphones, ordinateurs et autres supports numériques pour en extraire des informations essentielles aux enquêtes judiciaires.

  • Garantir l'intégrité, la fiabilité et l'exploitabilité des données recueillies.

Relever des défis techniques

  • Identifier des composants défectueux et procéder à des réparations sur les ordinateurs et smartphones.

  • Imaginer et mettre en œuvre des solutions adaptées aux situations les plus complexes.

Développer les outils de demain

  • Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de nos logiciels internes d'aide à l'analyse.

  • Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour rendre les investigations plus efficaces et performantes.

  • Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des outils existants.
