title: Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle
descriptionHtml:
About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill.

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.


    • Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

    • What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. Work in the EU Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. Become a stock options holder Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. Receive unwavering support and care Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. Work & Swim program Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. title: Senior Data Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste : 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Consultant(e) pour accompagner la transformation Data & IA de nos clients C-Level (COMEX, marketing, digital, supply-chain, opérations, customer support, IT...). Le/la consultant(e) pilote avec une large autonomie des projets complets de bout en bout, supervisé(e) par un n+1 (manager, directeur, partner), et encadre les consultants plus juniors. 

Missions : 

  • Piloter un ou plusieurs streams : garantir le delivery, identifier les points de blocage, proposer des solutions, assurer la gestion de projet (documentation, planning, comptes-rendus)
  • Encadrer et donner des feedbacks constructifs aux membres juniors de l'équipe
  • Produire de manière autonome les livrables de mission : présentations, benchmarks, études de cas, workshop decks, sections steerco
  • Rédiger des storylines et concevoir des slides percutantes
  • Animer les interviews et workshops clients
  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les clients et identifier des opportunités business
  • Contribuer au développement d'Artefact : développement d'une offre, d'une industrie, d'un chapter ou d'un partenariat école ; participation au recrutement et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants
  • Soutenir et développer une ou plusieurs expertises internes (stratégie, data governance, data marketing...) via la construction d'offres, la formation, ou des actions marketing

Profil recherché :

  • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en cabinet de conseil
  • Double profil "business" et "data" : curieux(se), passionné(e) par la data et les évolutions technologiques
  • Esprit analytique, goût pour la résolution de problèmes
  • Expérience en gestion de clients et identification d'opportunités commerciales
  • Maîtrise de la Suite Google/Pack Office et des outils de workshop ; excellente communication en français et en anglais (écrit/oral)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre : 

  • Localisation en plein cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Environnement pluridisciplinaire en forte croissance
  • Formations régulières et montée en compétences sur les méthodes de travail tech (product mindset, agilité)
  • Culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur l'innovation, la collaboration et l'action

Process de recrutement : 

  • HR Interview : 30/45' - entretien de motivation, culture et éligibilité avec un(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • Consulting Manager : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Consulting Director : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Partner : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

This role is within The Goat Agency, a leading brand within WPP Media, where you will help global brands harness the power of social and creator-led content to deliver measurable impact. Recognised as a global leader in the space, we deliver award-winning campaigns in more than 70 countries. With over 650 social natives worldwide, we create ambitious influencer programmes—from tactical activations to long-term partnerships—designed to drive awareness, engagement and conversions across the full marketing funnel.

Working within the Intelligence and Insights team, you will support the development of clear, relevant and actionable insights that inform campaign planning and strategy. You will explore consumer behaviour, social conversations, creator activity, competitor performance and cultural trends, turning your findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations. This is an early-career opportunity suited to someone with one to two years of marketing, research, social media or insights experience who is curious about audiences, brands and culture.

Intelligence & Research Operations:

  • Gather and organise information from internal and external sources, ensuring findings are clearly documented and easy to understand.
  • Support the maintenance of campaign tracking documents, research libraries and shared intelligence resources.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer – AI Infrastructure (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als unsere erste dedizierte DevOps-Person verantwortest du Infrastruktur und Betrieb von MAIA und entwickelst unsere bestehende Plattform für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt weiter. Die Rolle lebt von enger Abstimmung mit dem Engineering-Team.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Plattform und Deployments. Der Großteil unserer Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner, auf dedizierten Servern und Cloud-VMs. Du betreibst diese selbst administrierten Linux-Systeme und bindest ergänzend Dienste von AWS, Azure und GCP an, vor allem für KI-Services. Mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und erprobten Rollbacks machst du Änderungen sicher und reproduzierbar.

  • PostgreSQL im Betrieb. Du verantwortest Performance, Connection Pooling und Kapazitäten und stellst mit getesteten Backups und Restores sicher, dass wir Daten zuverlässig wiederherstellen können.

  • Observability. Du entwickelst unseren selbst betriebenen Observability-Stack weiter, verbindest Metriken, Logs und Traces und etablierst Alerting, das zu konkreten Handlungen führt.

  • Sicherheit und Compliance. Du setzt Least Privilege, Secrets Management, Vulnerability Scanning und Patch Management konsequent um. Für unser laufendes ISO-27001-Vorhaben automatisierst du prüfbare Nachweise.

Was wir suchen

  • Selbst betriebene Systeme. Du hast produktive SaaS-Systeme auf selbst administrierten Linux-Servern betrieben. Erfahrung ausschließlich mit vollständig gemanagten Cloud-Diensten reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus. Erfahrung mit Hetzner ist ein Plus.

  • Container und Automatisierung. Docker und Docker Compose setzt du sicher in Produktion ein, ebenso Reverse Proxies oder API Gateways wie Traefik oder Kong. Infrastruktur verwaltest du mit Terraform, NixOS oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen, CI/CD baust du mit GitHub Actions oder ähnlichen Systemen.

  • PostgreSQL in Produktion. Backups und Restores hast du selbst eingerichtet und getestet. Performance-Analyse und Connection Pooling sind dir vertraut.

  • Observability und Sicherheit. Du hast einen Observability-Stack selbst betrieben, etwa mit Grafana, Loki und Prometheus. Sicherheit setzt du im Alltag um, von Berechtigungen und Secrets bis zu Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Verständnis für KI-Systeme. Du kennst die Grundlagen von RAG-Systemen und ihre typischen Fehlerquellen im Betrieb. Bei LLM-Serving kannst du Zielkonflikte zwischen Latenz, Durchsatz, Kosten und Betriebsaufwand einordnen. Neue Modelle und Anbieter verfolgst du aus eigenem Interesse.

  • Eigenständig und sorgfältig. Du treibst Themen selbst voran, untersuchst unbekannte Systeme, bis du sie verstehst, und priorisierst nach Risiko und Wirkung. Komplexität hältst du beherrschbar, und Verbesserungen bringst du bis in den laufenden Betrieb.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag, auch bei Infrastruktur. Du prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch, besonders bevor etwas in Produktion geht.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Auch bei Störungen bleibst du ruhig und klar. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du verständlich, auch Menschen ohne technischen Hintergrund. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle ist eine Senior-Rolle ohne Personalverantwortung.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 80.000 bis 90.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Engineer to join our Platform team supporting Spacecraft Operations. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in supporting other disciplines by focusing on the embedded software aspects of our satellite systems. The Platform team interfaces directly with many engineering groups to conduct R&D, design, manufacturing, and operations activities, ultimately ensuring all current and future spacecraft systems satisfy their mission.

Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years!

What You'll Do as a Senior Embedded Software Engineer:

  • Design, implement and test, deploy and maintain embedded firmware
  • Collaborate with other engineering functions on scoping, architecture and system design
  • Resolve on-orbit and on-ground issues related to embedded systems
  • Implement, optimize and maintain various serial protocols
  • Design and develop interface tools to improve abstraction between the embedded system and other satellite components
  • Debug and resolve complex embedded systems issues in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain technical documentation

Key Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Mastery of Embedded C programming language
  • Proficiency with scripting languages like Python and Bash
  • Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), specifically FreeRTOS
  • Familiarity with serial protocols and implementations
  • Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging embedded systems
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Experience developing on Linux (Ubuntu)
  • A base level of mathematical knowledge (engineering mathematic or similar)
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with space systems or satellite technology
  • Familiarity working to coding standards and using static analysis tools
  • Experience writing Rust for resource constrained environments (embedded Linux)
  • Experience with embedded Linux
  • Knowledge of control systems and algorithms

Tools and Technologies:

  • FreeRTOS for real-time operating system implementation
  • GNU ARM Embedded Toolchain for code compilation
  • GDB for debugging, complemented by extensive use of serial and/or CAN debugging
  • Experience with debugging techniques for systems without JTAG access, particularly for remote issue resolution
  • Familiarity with manual testing procedures for embedded interface code
  • Experience working with Arm Cortex Microcontrollers

title: Senior Engineering Manager, IaaS
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the IaaS group builds the layer they stand on: Kubernetes, networking, and storage, running on our own bare metal.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. The org hires about ten engineers a month, and this group carries one of the largest shares.

The Role

You will lead three teams: Managed Kubernetes, Network, and Storage. Managed K8s and Network run today, each with its own lead. Storage is yours to build: charter, first lead, first hires, first systems in production. The group is about a dozen engineers today and roughly doubles this year.

Your reports are team leads. The work is direction, staffing, and the seams between the teams: where Kubernetes meets the network, where both meet storage, and where the group meets the metal underneath. You stay technical enough to challenge architecture calls and to know when to trust the people making them.

This is a second-line seat for an engineer who moved into management to build world-class organisations. Opportunities like this don’t come up often.

What You Will Do

  • Own delivery and health across three teams' roadmaps. Projects ship with the reliability that finance, healthcare, and public-sector workloads demand.

  • Manage and grow team leads. Set the standard, hold it, and grow the ones who want your seat one day.

  • Build the Storage team from zero: define its charter (object and block storage, capacity planning, tiering, backup), hire its lead and engineers, and put the first systems into production.

  • Own the seams: architecture that crosses Kubernetes, network, and storage, and the boundary with the fleet and hardware-design groups below you.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities and make the tradeoffs between what customers need now and what the platform has to become.

  • Hire. Your group carries a big block of the org's openings; you build the machine that fills it and onboards people fast.

  • Raise the engineering bar through mentoring, feedback, and the standard your leads copy.

What We're Looking For

  • You have led multiple engineering teams in production infrastructure as a second-line manager. Managing managers, running several teams at once, is the experience we need.

  • Your ground is orchestration: you have run Kubernetes or compute orchestration at real scale, shipped systems in Go, and worked on Linux itself, below the managed-service layer.

  • You know network and storage well enough to challenge specialists and tell a sound design from a lucky one.

  • You are comfortable next to hardware. This group runs on Mistral's own metal, and you will work with the fleet and hardware teams every week.

  • You have built a team from nothing: written the charter, made the first hires, shipped the first system.

  • You have grown leaders, not only engineers. People you managed now run teams of their own.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite.

Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip AI kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wir im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
descriptionHtml:
💰 Up to £95k depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Close, audit, tax and payments operations are already covered by the finance team. What has not been built yet is planning. This role exists to make planning a discipline the leadership team uses every week: a forecast budget owners trust, and unit economics that change decisions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Analyst/Senior Commercial Analyst to build and own Fanvue's company model, forecasting and commercial analysis, reporting to our VP Finance.

This is hands-on. You will build the driver-based model the executive team and board run the business on, turn creator, fan and payments data into unit economics people act on, and partner directly with budget owners across the business. It suits someone who has built models from scratch, pulls their own data, and can put a number on every outcome they claim.

This is not a reporting role. Someone strong on reporting but weak on building models is the wrong hire here, however polished.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Build and own the company model: a driver-based forecast with base, upside and downside cases that leadership and the board use

  • Forecast GMV and net revenue from the real drivers: creators, paying fans, spend per fan, cohorts, seasonality and take rate

  • Run the budget and monthly reforecast, and explain variances in terms budget owners can act on

  • Analyse unit economics, cohorts, pricing and margin, and use that analysis to change pricing and deal decisions

  • Partner with department heads on spend, bringing data and options rather than simply saying no

  • Pull your own data with SQL, reconcile it back to the ledger, and automate reporting so it runs without you

  • Bring AI tools into the planning and reporting workflow

  • Own monthly investor reporting and contribute to board packs and fundraising data rooms

👀 Who You Are

  • You have built a driver-based forecast or company model from scratch, and can walk through every driver in it

  • You have done analysis that changed a pricing, deal or spending decision, and you know the numbers before and after

  • You write SQL and are comfortable in a BI tool. You do not wait for someone else to hand you the data

  • You have run budget reviews with department heads and are trusted by them

  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace, payments, subscription or e-commerce business

  • A scale-up background, ideally having built something from scratch in ambiguity and chosen that stage

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy or a high-risk payments category

  • Exposure to a fundraise or a data room

  • Reporting pipelines automated end to end

  • Background in STEM

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build the planning function rather than maintain a model someone else designed

  • You would rather pull the data yourself than wait for it

  • You like being in the room when the decision is made, not reporting on it afterwards

  • You are comfortable telling a department head the number does not support the spend, and then helping them find a way that does

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You see FP&A as reporting, and want a finished model to maintain

  • You need an ERP or established planning tools in place before you can start

  • You prefer to police budgets rather than partner with the people who own them

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Build planning from the ground up at a company growing this fast

  • Direct exposure to leadership, the board and investor reporting

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the work you do now sets the standard for years

  • Unlimited holiday

  • Hybrid working, with flexible hours according to when you work best

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing, plus support with upskilling and development costs

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Senior Graphic Designer

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.

Art direction and creation

  • Imagine visual concepts and key visuals for product launches and campaigns.

Exploration and ideas

Brand identity

AI and new tools

Production and collaboration

title: Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team.

Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define performance, functional, installation and other applicable system requirements, allocate them to components, and plan and support their validation and verification (V&V) in line with standards such as ARP4754.

  • Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements.

  • Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft structure and related systems.

  • Lead technical tasks for Microliner development and certification, and create system documentation from requirements definition to demonstration of compliance.

  • Define aircraft-level HV electrical bonding and grounding requirements and their implementation.

  • Coordinate HV system safety analyses and systems engineering activities, address environmental conditions including HIRF and EMI, and define lightning protection requirements for the HV propulsion electrical network based on the defined aircraft lightning zones.

  • Define and specify the aircraft charging interface, and break down its requirements to component level.

  • Specify power quality and electrical insulation requirements and draft the aircraft electrical load analysis, including tasks such as defining and maintaining a Y-capacitance budget for the propulsion electrical network and allocating limits to components.

  • Support integration of the HV system digital mock-up (DMU) into the aircraft 3D model.

  • Identify, assess and manage suppliers, and own work packages for the development, installation and integration of HV components, including fuses, switches, harnesses and grounding systems.

  • Perform or support analyses and simulations to improve HV propulsion battery performance, reliability and integration into the propulsion system.

  • Participate in supplier technical and program reviews (TRM and PRM) and key milestones, including PDR, CDR, First Flight and Type Certification.

  • Define and plan HV equipment qualification campaigns with the Technology Department, suppliers and other stakeholders.

  • Prepare, commission, troubleshoot and execute HV hardware and software tests, from component benches to full-scale prototypes and aircraft ground and flight tests.

  • Follow engineering processes and standards, and contribute to design reviews supporting development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years in electrical systems design and integration within an aerospace OEM or similar industry (preferably automotive).

  • Experience with electric aircraft is a plus, including power electronics, energy storage and electric propulsion systems.

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering and safety analyses per aerospace standards such as ARP4754 and ARP4761 or automotive standard such as ISO26262. Proficiency on airborne hardware and software qualification per ED-12/ED-80 (DO-178/DO-254), and practical experience with aircraft certification is a plus.

  • Practical experience with aircraft certification process (preferably EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25).

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J Design Organization, or international equivalent is preferred.

  • Assertive and clear communication skills, results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Ability to interact efficiently with customers, authorities, suppliers, and internal organizational units.

  • Proven ability to prioritize, manage, and execute multiple simultaneous tasks.

  • Skilled in navigating early design uncertainties and driving progress through proactive proposals and collaborative idea sharing.

  • Positive and optimistic attitude, with a collaborative approach in a multicultural team, adhering to company rules and values.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR-afdeling en administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR-processen, toepassing van arbeidsvoorwaarden en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR-medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. You will own the hands-on configuration and rollout of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Device Trust and Unified Access while delivering tailored, high-impact training that drives deep adoption and long-term customer value. Partnering with a Project Manager, Technical Account Managers, and Solutions Architects, you will be the trusted authority in each engagement, bringing both advanced product expertise and sharp business acumen to complex, high-visibility deployments. You will approach your work as an AI builder by actively developing AI-powered workflows and automation to scale your impact, accelerate outcomes for customers, and raise the standard for what implementation excellence looks like at 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

What we're looking for:

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to engage and develop relationships, sharing information effectively across all professional levels.

  • Excellent communication in Spanish is a plus

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, customer onboarding, or related B2B SaaS function, with a demonstrated track record of leading enterprise software deployments for large, complex, or strategically critical organizations

  • Advanced technical expertise and hands-on experience deploying SaaS products in enterprise environments, including deep working knowledge of identity providers (IdPs), SSO, SCIM, Active Directory, MDM, device trust, and Zero Trust security frameworks

  • Expert-level understanding of the business cases for enterprise security, IT operations, and SaaS governance tools and able to fluently navigate both technical and strategic conversations with IT administrators, security teams, and C-suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, high-visibility enterprise engagements with multiple competing priorities, maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines

  • Proven ability to design and deliver advanced, engaging virtual training and enablement programs for enterprise customers, including technically sophisticated administrators and executive audiences

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leadership and serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders

  • Strong judgment in identifying and resolving technical issues, with the ability to lead de-escalation efforts and drive outcomes autonomously

  • A builder's mindset toward AI. You actively develop with AI tools and automation, creating workflows, solutions, and accelerators that meaningfully improve how you and your team work; you are not a casual user but a practitioner who builds

  • Experience mentoring and coaching peers and junior team members, sharing expertise and elevating the capability of those around you

  • Familiarity with SCIM, AD/LDAP, CLI, SSO, BYOD, MDM, SaaS discovery, and device posture concepts

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 1Password or experience deploying identity and access management, password management, device trust, or SaaS management solutions at enterprise scale

What you can expect:

  • Drive the successful technical implementation and deployment of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, and Device Trust (and Unified Access as it becomes available) for large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, owning hands-on configuration, integration, and validation through to a successful launch

  • Partner with the assigned Project Manager to align on timelines, dependencies, and internal coordination. You own the technical delivery and customer enablement while the Project Manager owns project coordination; together you ensure a seamless, high-quality customer experience

  • Collaborate closely with Technical Account Managers and Solutions Architects to assess customer environments, align on architectural decisions, and design implementation approaches that meet both technical requirements and business objectives

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's environment, security posture, business goals, and user workflows in order to design deployment strategies and training plans that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Deliver advanced, customized virtual training sessions for enterprise administrators and end users across all deployed 1Password products while adapting instructional approaches to technically diverse audiences and highly complex organizational environments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for customers and internal stakeholders alike, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from IT and security teams to executive leadership

  • Manage escalated situations on complex or sensitive implementations, working cross-functionally with internal teams and engaging directly with customers to de-escalate and drive the best possible outcome

  • Exercise independent judgment in identifying and mitigating implementation risks, developing and executing resolution strategies proactively and keeping all relevant stakeholders informed

  • Stay ahead of product updates, new features, and evolving integrations across our products and applying that knowledge immediately in customer engagements and sharing it with the broader team

  • Develop and maintain advanced implementation playbooks, training curricula, and enablement resources (including configuration guides, deployment frameworks, and possibly video content) that elevate the capabilities of the entire Implementations and Onboarding team

  • Mentor Implementation Managers and other junior team members, sharing deep product expertise, enterprise deployment strategies, and insights gained from working with our most demanding customers

  • Influence team operations by leveraging lessons from complex engagements to recommend and drive improvements to team practices, processes, documentation, and the overall customer journey

  • Build with AI not just use it. Actively develop AI-powered workflows, automation, and tools that improve your own delivery, help customers achieve faster time-to-value, and create scalable solutions the broader team can adopt

  • Contribute significantly to the growth strategy of the Implementations function, identifying opportunities to evolve how we deploy and enable customers at scale

  • Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £61,000 GBP and £88,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

 

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

 

Problems you'll work on

  • Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback.

  • Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter.

  • Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

  • One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

  • Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

  • Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

  • Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

  • Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

  • Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

  • Take prototypes from your research-focused teammates and turn them into shipped features

  • Contribute to platform design decisions, take part in design reviews and help us hire

  • Work with Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Kubernetes and GCP/AWS

     

Who we're looking for

  • An owner. You take ambiguous product needs, make the architecture calls and carry the work all the way into production.

  • A systems thinker. You design for scale and reuse, and you know when a simple, solid baseline beats a clever solution.

  • A great collaborator. You enjoy working across research, product and engineering, and you make it easier for everyone to ship.

  • A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time building and operating ML systems or model-backed products in production at scale

  • Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience deploying modern deep learning models in production, with a strong understanding of model serving, inference optimisation, GPU utilisation and performance trade-offs.

  • Experience designing and operating scalable, distributed production systems, ideally involving GPU workloads, high-throughput data processing or low-latency inference.

  • The ability to reason through an ML system end to end, from data and model choices to offline and online evaluation, deployment, monitoring and retraining

  • A track record of personally owning complex systems from design through to production

  • Bonus: computer vision or multimodal deployment experience (not required), model-serving frameworks, or experience with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Daily company lunches

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

  • Deep discovery skills: you ask the 2nd, 3rd and 4th question until you reach the real business problem

  • A forecasting method you've actually run, and the discipline to inspect it weekly

  • Urgency and a competitive streak. You'd rather get on a plane to see the customer than send another email

  • Coachable, and able to coach others. You can name feedback that changed how you work

  • Experience moving customers onto AI products is a strong plus

  • Audit, accounting or professional services software experience is a strong plus

What We Offer

title: Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten & Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen. 
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei. 
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen. 

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media bist du die strategische und operative Schlüsselfigur für unsere Großkund. Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Retail-Media-Aktivitäten – von Amazon und weiteren Marktplätzen über führende Retailer bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Formaten.

  • Strategie & Jahresplanung: Du entwickelst ganzheitliche Commerce- und Retail-Media-Strategien für deine Kunden, definierst KPI-Ziele und erstellst die Mediaplanung über alle relevanten Touchpoints und Funnel-Stufen hinweg.
  • Kundenführung & Management: Du führst den Kunden partnerschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe, steuerst die regelmäßige Kommunikation (inkl. internationaler Stakeholder) und präsentierst Ergebnisse sowie strategische Roadmaps in Reviews.
  • Ganzheitliche Kampagnensteuerung (A–Z): Du verantwortest das Kampagnenmanagement über das gesamte Retail-Netzwerk – von Amazon (Sponsored Ads & DSP) über führende Retailer (dm, Rossmann, REWE etc.) bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Aktivierungen (Prime Video, Spotify).
  • Operatives Setup & Aussteuerung: Du übernimmst das hands-on Kampagnen-Setup – von der Keyword- und Audience-Recherche über die Kampagnenstruktur bis hin zum täglichen Bid- und Pacing-Management, um Budgets optimal auszuschöpfen.
  • Laufende Optimierung & Testing: Du justierst Gebote, Match Types und Zielgruppen, führst Tests&Learn durch, optimierst und hebst kontinuierlich Performance-Potenziale.
  • Budget- & Rentabilitätsverantwortung: Du steuerst und überwachst signifikante Mediabudgets eigenverantwortlich, behältst ROAS sowie Effizienzmetriken im Blick und optimierst den Media-Mix kontinuierlich.
  • Datenanalyse & Insights: Du analysierst Performance-, Sortiments- und Marktdaten, erkennst Wachstumshebel und übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in klare Handlungsempfehlungen für den Kunden.
  • Fachliche Teamleitung: Du strukturierst und koordinierst Aufgaben innerhalb eines kleinen Teams, coachst Kolleg:innen auf Junior- und Mid-Level fachlich und sorgst für reibungslose operative Abläufe.
  • Innovation & Weiterentwicklung: Du treibst Best Practices voran, testest neue AdTech-Möglichkeiten und gestaltest die Entwicklung unseres Commerce-Bereichs aktiv mit.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, Performance Marketing oder E-Commerce (idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite).
  • Fundiertes Plattform-Wissen: Du hast nachweisbare Praxis in der Planung, dem Setup und der Optimierung von Kampagnen im Bereich Advertising (Sponsored Ads und DSP).
  • Ganzheitliches Retail-Verständnis: Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Retailern und Marken (egal ob Drogerie, Food oder Marktplatz) und hast Lust, Kampagnen über mehrere Handelsplattformen hinweg strategisch zu orchestrieren.
  • Strategische & analytische Denkweise: Du denkst in Business-Zielen, verstehst Kennzahlen im Detail und kannst fundierte Mediapläne und Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln.
  • Souveräne Kundenführung: Du trittst überzeugend auf, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich präsentieren und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Führungs- & Organisationsgeschick: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Aufgaben im Team strukturiert zu koordinieren, zu delegieren und Kolleg:innen fachlich zu unterstützen.
  • Persönlichkeit & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst proaktiv mit, packst bei operativen Herausforderungen selbst mit an und bringst eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit.
  • Nice to Have: Erfahrungen mit weiteren Retail-Plattformen und AdTechs wie Criteo, CitrusAd oder The Trade Desk sowie Tools wie Pacvue, Skai oder Helium10. Kenntnisse in Streaming-Advertising und BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Looker Studio sind ebenfalls ein Plus.

 Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamorientiert #analytisch #kommunikativ #proaktiv #lösungsorientiert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
