title: Senior Manager, New Business DACH & Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH & Benelux.

About the job

This position is needed to lead one of our New Business Account Executive teams selling into DACH & Benelux within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South & DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced sales leader who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution-selling Account Executives disciplined in driving new logo acquisition and expanding market presence.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build and manage a high performing team of account executives focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and driving new logo growth.
  • Coach and lead a team to identify and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.
  • Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.
  • Work closely with our Marketing, Professional Services & Partner teams to build a robust pipeline and accelerate time-to-value for new prospects.
  • Forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company. 
  • Experience in building teams, driving pipeline creation, managing monthly forecasting, supporting fiscal planning, and tracking revenue for new business accounts.
  • Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries. 
  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.
  • Industry experience in selling CPaaS or SaaS and managing complex sales negotiations. 
  • Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.
  • A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent required. 
  • Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence. 
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.
  • Fluent in German or Dutch

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Manager, Obligations Management
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As the Senior Manager, Obligations Management, you'll manage and continue to develop the central governance infrastructure used to identify, catalogue, and track regulatory and financial partner requirements across Airwallex’s global footprint. You’ll translate complex requirements into a structured, data-driven, and audit-ready compliance inventory that supports consistent execution across a distributed global organization.

  • Own and continuously improve the Global Obligations Register, cataloguing international regulatory rules, statutory requirements, and Tier 1 financial partner obligations alongside their compliance controls.

  • Partner with Risk and Compliance stakeholders to structure mapped controls and reporting obligations for effective independent monitoring, validation, and testing.

  • Manage and evolve the central global RFI knowledge base, synthesising input from Regulatory Compliance teams and curating consistent, well-supported evidence portfolios for banking partners and regulatory bodies.

  • Maintain the global central audit register, tracking internal audit findings, external examination gaps, and material regulatory issues while driving accountability for remediation and verified closure.

  • Partner with Regulatory Legal teams to incorporate legal interpretations and horizon-scanning insights, keeping the obligations registry current and reducing the risk of compliance gaps or control drift.

  • Establish and improve operating procedures, data standards, governance routines, and reporting for obligations management, RFI responses, and audit issue tracking.

  • Identify opportunities to replace manual trackers and spreadsheet dependencies with scalable GRC tooling, workflow automation, and compliance dashboards, supporting implementation and adoption with relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate and influence regional and cross-functional contributors to maintain consistent central standards while reflecting local regulatory requirements.

  • Produce clear management reporting and concise analysis on obligations coverage, control mapping, RFI readiness, audit issues, remediation progress, and emerging risks.

This is a remote role based in Birmingham, UK.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8 to 10+ years of experience in corporate governance, regulatory compliance, internal audit, operational risk management, or a related discipline within a highly regulated financial services, fintech, or banking environment.

  • 3+ years of experience managing a compliance inventory, regulatory obligations framework, audit issue program, RFI process, or GRC work stream in a multi-jurisdictional environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building or maintaining compliance matrices, mapping internal controls to regulatory requirements, managing audit or examination issues, and coordinating evidence or RFI responses.

  • Strong ability to translate complex regulatory or legal requirements into clear processes, data structures, ownership models, and actionable reporting.

  • A high-ownership, systematic approach to problem-solving, with strong written communication and corporate drafting skills.

  • Proven ability to influence and coordinate regional and cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed organization without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Experience improving operational processes and implementing practical tooling, workflows, or reporting solutions in a fast-growing environment.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Policy, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.

  • Juris Doctor, Master of Laws, or a master’s degree in Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, or Business Administration.

  • Professional designation such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist, Certified Internal Auditor, or an equivalent GRC-related credential.

  • Experience working within a high-growth cross-border payments company, top-tier neobank, or API-driven digital platform handling high volumes of regulated transactions.

  • Direct experience selecting, deploying, or configuring Governance, Risk, and Compliance software to support regulatory mapping, evidence management, issue remediation, or workflow automation.

  • Experience leading projects or mentoring colleagues in obligations management, regulatory change management, compliance operations, audit, or related programs.

You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.Z

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Manager, Products & Services - Consumer Products & Retail
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Consumer Products & Retail Transformation practice are looking for a Senior Manager/Director to join the team

Our Consumer Products & Retail practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager or Director to join the team and help our clients deliver complex, business-critical transformation.

We are seeking a highly motivated consulting leader with a strong track record of designing and delivering large-scale transformation programmes within the consumer products and retail sectors. This could include experience across supply chain transformation, S&OP, planning and forecasting, ERP-enabled transformation, or operating model design and implementation.

This is a broad transformation leadership role rather than a position focused on a single functional specialism. The right person will combine strong consulting and programme leadership capabilities with the commercial confidence to lead client relationships, manage complex engagements, and identify opportunities to deepen and grow existing accounts.

Candidates may have built their career entirely within consulting or combined consulting with relevant industry experience. However, substantial consulting experience and a clear understanding of how to lead clients through complex transformation are essential.

What we are looking for

You will be a pragmatic transformation leader who is comfortable moving between strategic thinking and the realities of implementation. You will understand what it takes to mobilise and deliver complex programmes, engage senior client stakeholders, and create alignment across business and technology teams.

You do not need to be a pure business development or new-logo origination specialist. However, you must be comfortable owning senior client relationships, leading the day-to-day development of accounts, and identifying opportunities to broaden our impact with existing clients.

You will also bring enough depth in consumer products or retail to understand the commercial and operational context in which clients are transforming, while retaining the breadth to work across different types of transformation challenge.

What you will be doing

  • Lead complex transformation engagements for consumer products and retail clients, taking responsibility for successful delivery from initial design through to implementation.
  • Help clients shape and deliver transformation across areas such as supply chain, S&OP, business planning, forecasting, ERP implementation, and operating model effectiveness.
  • Translate strategic objectives into practical transformation roadmaps, delivery plans, governance structures, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead the day-to-day management of major client accounts and engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a confident and credible account leader who can strengthen client relationships, identify emerging needs, and grow existing accounts.
  • Oversee complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, business functions, technology platforms, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
  • Work across business and technology teams to ensure that transformation programmes deliver sustainable operational improvements rather than standalone systems or process changes.
  • Advise clients on the organisational, process, capability, data, and technology changes required to deliver successful transformation.
  • Provide clear leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, creating an environment in which consultants can perform effectively and develop their capabilities.
  • Manage programme risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, governance, and senior stakeholder expectations.
  • Support business development activity through proposal development, solution design, client presentations, and the expansion of existing relationships.
  • Contribute to the continued development of our Consumer Products & Retail practice, including its propositions, delivery capabilities, market profile, and people.

Your skills and experience

  • Significant experience within consulting, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation engagements for consumer products or retail clients.
  • Experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or an equivalent level within a recognised consulting organisation.
  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more of the following areas:
    • Supply chain transformation
    • Sales and operations planning, or S&OP
    • Demand, supply, or integrated business planning
    • Forecasting and planning transformation
    • ERP-enabled business transformation
    • Operating model design and implementation
    • Complex programme leadership
  • Experience leading major transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and business adoption.
  • A strong understanding of how business processes, operating models, data, technology, organisation design, and change management come together within a successful transformation.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary consulting teams and manage multiple workstreams within complex client environments.
  • Strong client engagement and account management skills, with the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders and manage important day-to-day relationships.
  • Evidence of growing or expanding existing client accounts by identifying additional client needs and converting them into relevant opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, scope, risk, and client expectations.
  • The ability to communicate complex transformation topics clearly and credibly to both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a strong commitment to coaching and developing consulting talent.
  • Industry experience gained before, during, or after a consulting career would be valuable, but candidates must bring substantial and current consulting capability.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.
Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

  • Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.


    • Requirements

  • You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

  • You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

  • You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Network Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal ein gewachsenes Netzwerk neu geordnet:
Segmente getrennt, Standorte sauber angebunden und alles so dokumentiert, dass auch andere damit arbeiten können? Und Sie möchten genau das jetzt über mehrere Standorte und mit voller Verantwortung umsetzen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel und Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis.

Warum diese Rolle

Das Netzwerk ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird jetzt neu strukturiert. Die Netze werden getrennt und segmentiert, die Produktionsnetze abgesichert, und es entstehen verbindliche Standards. Ziel ist eine performante, ausfallsichere und gegen Angriffe belastbare Netzwerklandschaft, auf der alle IT-Services aufsetzen.

• Weil Sie die Netzarchitektur über mehrere Standorte selbst prägen.

• Weil Ihre Arbeit sichtbar wird: in stabilen Verbindungen, sauberen Segmenten und einer Doku, mit der andere arbeiten können.

• Weil eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen Rückhalt gibt, auch wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb klappt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von LAN, WAN und Backbone an allen Standorten

• Routing und Switching inklusive VLAN-Konzept und Redundanz

• Standortvernetzung per VPN und sichere Remote-Zugänge

• Betrieb der Firewalls (Fortinet) und Neuordnung gewachsener Regelwerke

• Segmentierung der Netze und Trennung von IT und OT, damit die Produktion geschützt läuft

• WLAN und Access Points

• Netzpläne, IP-Adressverwaltung und Standards, die das Netz für alle nachvollziehbar machen

Zur Einordnung: Security-Monitoring und SIEM betreibt ein externer Partner, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Clients, Server und Anwendungen betreuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im IT-Team. Ihr Schwerpunkt ist das Netzwerk selbst, von der Verkabelung bis zum Routing.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Netzwerkadministrator oder Network Engineer, idealerweise inhouse in einem Industrie- oder Produktionsunternehmen

• Sie haben Netze konzipiert, strukturiert und dokumentiert, gern auch als Allrounder mit klarem Netzwerkschwerpunkt in einem kleineren Unternehmen.

• Fundiertes Know-how in Routing und Switching sowie Erfahrung mit der Vernetzung mehrerer Standorte, idealerweise international

• Praxis mit Fortinet oder vergleichbaren Enterprise-Lösungen, etwa Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco oder Sophos

• Erfahrung mit Produktionsnetzen und der Trennung von IT und OT

• Sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit den Standorten

• Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Cisco CCNA/CCNP oder vergleichbar

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Dazu kommen projektbezogene Reisen zu den Standorten.

• Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Bikeleasing

• Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Hersteller-Zertifizierungen

Gehalt

60.000–70.000 € brutto im Jahr plus Tantieme, je nach Erfahrung

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin. Stefan Schulz meldet sich bei Ihnen für ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.

title: Senior Packaging Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Packaging Engineer, you will lead IC packaging initiatives from conceptualization and design to manufacturing process selection. You will establish the necessary supply chain, manage sub-contractors, and oversee the NPI and ramp-up phases for current and future Arago devices.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Integrated Circuits Design.

  • 5+ years of experience in the semiconductor and photonic packaging industry.

  • Proficiency in heterogeneous integration and packaging processes, including wafer dicing (stealth, blade, diamond scribing), high-density Cu pillars and advanced bumping, flip-chip, redistribution layer and encapsulation (thermal lid, compression molding, glob-top), die attach and bonding techniques (epoxy, attach film, reflow, thermocompression, eutectic, laser-assisted bonding, Cu-Cu direct bonding), wirebonding, and 2.5D/3D integration schemes (back grinding, TSV reveal, die stacking, interposer).

  • Strong expertise in photonic and optoelectronic packaging and micro-scale optical alignment, including passive and active alignment of lenses and optical fibers, fine die placement (precision < 1µm), and experience with InP, GaAs, and other non-Si semiconductors.

  • Proficiency in thermal, mechanical, and EM simulations.

  • Strong understanding of packaging industrialization, production flows, high-yield and scale manufacturing, failure analysis, and Six Sigma methodology is a plus.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Design packaging solutions spanning from initial drawings and simulations to DFM.

  • Identify, vet, and manage external sub-contractors.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with IC design, optical, and PCB teams to align packaging specifications across domains.

  • Lead the chip industrialization process, ensuring high yield and Cpk.

  • Conduct thorough failure analysis and debugging.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

title: Senior Paid Social Manager

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

About You

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well.

You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling.

You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:

  • Owning and scaling paid social performance globally, ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms.
  • Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets, using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth.
  • Building an AI-enabled paid social team, deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way.
  • Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows, using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks.
  • Using AI and automation across the account, from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work.
  • Developing and executing the paid social roadmap, identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms.
  • Driving a full-funnel approach, from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives.
  • Championing attribution and measurement, ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation.
  • Leading creative strategy, working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance.
  • Staying ahead of industry changes, including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates, and new advertising solutions.
  • Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team, shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally.

You’ll be a great fit if:

  • You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms.
  • You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social.
  • You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices.
  • You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms.
  • You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making.
  • You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.).
  • You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation.
  • You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain.
  • You’re comfortable with Meta’s AI-led campaign products (Advantage+, automated bidding) and know when to trust automation and when to override it.
  • You have sound judgement on AI risk, including brand safety, accuracy of claims and data privacy, ideally in a regulated industry such as financial services.
  • You understand how to drive performance across web traffic, mobile apps, and lead generation channels.
  • You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation.
  • You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories.

What you’ll get in return:

At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. We trust our employees to work in a way that suits them while delivering great results. Our offices are always available for those who want to collaborate in person, and we support remote work across the UK.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.



Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

The Senior Product Analyst, Merchant will be the dedicated analytics lead for Zilch’s Merchant domain - the space where shopping discovery, merchant-funded advertising, paid display, paid search, affiliate conversion, and customer engagement come together.

Reporting into Product Analytics and partnering closely with the Senior Product Manager for Merchant, you’ll help build the analytical foundation for Zilch’s intelligent commerce platform. This is a two-sided problem: we need to improve the customer shopping experience while helping merchants drive measurable ROAS through Zilch’s closed-loop payments and behavioural data.

Here, paid display and paid search refer to advertising inventory we sell to merchants, not media we buy. You’ll help define how this inventory is measured, targeted, optimised, and monetised across the Zilch app.

You’ll analyse the full shopping journey - from browsing and search, through merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat engagement - to understand where users drop off, what drives intent, and which product features can improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation.

This is not a reporting-only role. The analysis, experimentation, and models you build will directly shape what customers see, how merchants are surfaced, and how we move from static merchandising towards data-driven discovery, allocation, and personalisation.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Own analytics for Zilch’s Merchant domain, covering shopping discovery, customer browsing behaviour, merchant-funded paid display and paid search, affiliate conversion, merchant ROAS, and marketplace performance.

  • Analyse the customer shopping journey across browsing, search, merchant discovery, unlocks, clickouts, transactions, and repeat usage to identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation.

  • Design and analyse experiments across merchant placements and shopping features, including targeted vs random allocation, paid display exposure, search ranking, storefront changes, offer discovery, and journey improvements.

  • Build the measurement framework for merchant-funded growth, including incrementality, attribution windows, exposed vs control logic, ROAS, CPA, conversion, revenue per impression, and margin impact.

  • Partner with Product and Commercial to shape audience packages and targeting strategies, ensuring they are commercially sellable, analytically measurable, and grounded in customer behaviour.

  • Develop segmentation approaches for merchant-funded display and search, including category affinity, value bands, browsing intent, cross-sell audiences, lapsed users, and future lookalike opportunities.

  • Support the evolution from simple segment-based targeting towards more advanced allocation logic, recommendation systems, and marketplace decisioning.

  • Work with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Engineering on the data foundations for merchant personalisation, including event tracking, feature creation, experimentation infrastructure, and model evaluation.

  • Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for Product, Commercial, and senior leadership.


What we're looking for...

  • Ideally, 5+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, marketplace analytics, retail media analytics, performance marketing analytics, data science, or a closely adjacent role.

  • Strong commercial judgement and fluency in ROAS, CPA, incrementality, attribution, LTV, conversion, margin, and marketplace trade-offs.

  • Deep data skills. You’re fluent in SQL, comfortable working with large behavioural datasets, and able to independently investigate ambiguous problems, define the right metrics, and produce robust analysis.

  • Rigorous experimentation experience. You can design clean A/B tests, reason about incrementality and power, interpret results honestly, and know when data is good enough to act on.

  • Experience analysing digital funnels, browsing behaviour, search behaviour, clickouts, conversion, paid placements, shopping discovery, or marketplace dynamics.

  • Experience with segmentation, targeting, personalisation, recommendation systems, ranking, marketplace allocation, retail media, or paid media measurement would be highly valuable.

  • Strong product instincts, with the ability to recommend and evaluate shopping features that improve customer engagement, discovery, conversion, and monetisation.

  • Commercially minded and comfortable working across Product and Sales. You can understand both customer value and merchant performance, and translate analysis into decisions that improve both.

  • Strong communicator who can explain complex analytical concepts clearly to Product, Commercial, and Executive stakeholders.

  • A proactive, growth-minded operator who is comfortable building analytical foundations in a new domain where the questions, data model, and product strategy are still evolving.

descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. 

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations 
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 83,726 - GBP 100,470. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Team

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

  • Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

  • Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

  • Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

  • Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

  • Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

  • Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

  • Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

  • Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

  • Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

  • Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

  • You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

  • You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

  • You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

  • You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

  • You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

  • You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

  • You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

  • You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

  • You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

  • Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

  • A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.
  • Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.
  • A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE  🎆

  • Retail, CPG, or retail media background
  • Multi-market experience
  • Can speak Italian or German

LOCATION 🌐 

While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜 

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.

Product Managers at Nscale own the definition, delivery, and ongoing evolution of a part of the Nscale cloud platform. PMs work across the full breadth of the Nscale cloud, from core infrastructure primitives to managed platform services, developer experience, and internal tools, wherever product leverage is needed.

In this role, you will own a major area of the cloud platform and drive end-to-end projects, from problem framing through launch and iteration, delivered within the EU and tailored to the needs of European customers and regulatory requirements.
