title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

  • Own a large, shared pool of accounts: Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

  • Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion: Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

  • Build community and drive engagement at scale: Design and run customer events, webinars, roundtables, and digital programmes that keep your accounts engaged, informed, and connected to each other. Co-host with Marketing and Sales, and turn your best customers into reference champions.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally: Translate patterns across your accounts into product feedback for the roadmap, and into scalable plays and campaigns for Marketing and Sales. Help define the playbooks, tools, and processes for managing accounts at this scale: you're building this function as much as running it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a book-of-business role. You work across a large, shared pool of accounts rather than owning a fixed set, so leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints matters as much as one-to-one relationship-building.

  • The quota skews toward retention and value realisation, not expansion. Roughly 70% of what you own is keeping accounts healthy and renewed; the other 30% is expansion you spot and hand off or close.

  • Community is core to the role, not a nice-to-have. You're expected to build and run the events, webinars, and content that turn a shared pool of customers into a connected group of Omnea advocates.

  • There's no fixed playbook for managing accounts at this scale yet. You'll help define it as you go.

About You

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, energised by building community, and have the operational discipline to manage a high-volume, shared pool of accounts without letting anything slip. You know how to create leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints, and you balance that with the relationship skills to make customers feel genuinely looked after.

  • 2-7 years of experience in a B2B SaaS commercial or customer-facing role. You might come from account management, customer success, marketing, or events - what matters is a genuine commercial edge and a track record of excellence in whatever you've done

  • You're a natural community builder: you know how to design and run programmes that bring customers together, and you understand how those moments translate into retention, expansion, and advocacy

  • You have strong commercial intuition: you can spot an expansion opportunity in a conversation, navigate a renewal proactively, and hold your own in commercial discussions with senior stakeholders

  • You're a brilliant communicator in every format: warm, clear, and credible whether you're hosting a webinar for 50 people or writing a customer newsletter

  • You're operationally excellent. Managing 50+ accounts at a time means ruthless prioritisation, tight organisation, and building systems and processes that create leverage

  • You're outcomes-focused with a heavy bias to action, entrepreneurial, and want to help build a business. The scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes it on

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Synthesis Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

title: Team Lead - Invoices
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

  • Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

  • Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

  • Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

  • Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

  • Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire

  • Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

  • Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities

  • Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

  • Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

  • Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers

  • Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

  • Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

  • Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring

  • You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

  • You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

  • You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

  • You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

  • You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

  • You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

  • You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get

  • A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

  • Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

  • A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

  • A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

  • Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.

 

As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.

 

If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.

 

What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

  • Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

  • Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

  • Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

  • Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

  • Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

  • Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

 

About You

  • You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

  • You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

  • You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

  • You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

  • You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

  • You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

  • You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • You’ve led a team through fast growth, ideally at a scale-up where the team and product changed quickly.

  • You’ve built B2B or enterprise SaaS, with complex workflows and demanding customers.

  • You’ve performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work.

 

Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it’s like to build at Omnea.

 

R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

 

Note: our pair programming stage is in TypeScript OR Python and you’ll be assessed as if it’s your primary language. This is a full-stack, hands-on leadership role, so if you’re exclusively frontend, backend, or platform-focused, or no longer writing code, it likely isn’t the right fit.

 

The process generally includes:

 

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge, language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

  3. Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

     

    • Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

    • System Design interview with a Senior Engineer (60 mins)

    • Engineering Leadership interview with our CTO (45 mins)

    • Office tour (15 mins)

 

We’re proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Teamleider logistiek Berkel en Rodenrijs
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij leidinggeven in een logistieke omgeving waar jouw inzet direct zichtbaar resultaat oplevert?

Als Teamleider Logistiek bij DPD in Berkel en Rodenrijs zorg jij ervoor dat onze dagelijkse sorteer- en distributieprocessen soepel, veilig en efficiënt verlopen. Je geeft leiding aan een team van vaste en flexibele medewerkers, bewaakt de voortgang en stuurt continu op kwaliteit, productiviteit en veiligheid.

Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer, motiveert collega's om het beste uit zichzelf te halen en signaleert kansen om processen slimmer in te richten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Samen met jouw team zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten dagelijks op tijd hun bestemming bereiken.

Lees verder en ontdek of deze baan bij jou past.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je gaat aan de slag op ons depot in Berkel en Rodenrijs, waar iedere dag duizenden pakketten worden verwerkt. Je werkt nauw samen met andere teamleiders, supervisors en operationele collega's.

Je werkt in een tweeploegendienst:

  • 15:00 uur tot 23:30 uur

  • 00:00 uur tot 08:30 uur

Daarnaast ben je incidenteel beschikbaar voor een zaterdagdienst.

Wat ga je doen?

Je start jouw dienst met een overdracht van je collega, controleert de operationele resultaten en bespreekt de planning met jouw team. Gedurende de dienst houd je overzicht, stuur je medewerkers aan en los je operationele knelpunten op. Je bewaakt de KPI's en zorgt ervoor dat de werkzaamheden veilig en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Coördineren en aansturen van de dagelijkse logistieke operatie.

  • Opstellen en bewaken van personeels- en capaciteitsplanningen.

  • Motiveren, coachen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers.

  • Bewaken van productiviteit, kwaliteit en operationele KPI's.

  • Signaleren van knelpunten en implementeren van procesverbeteringen.

  • Toezien op naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften en werkinstructies.

  • Verzorgen van rapportages en een goede overdracht naar collega's en management.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.931,25 en € 4.187,50 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie van 38,75 uur per week (1 fte).

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag):

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur en 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen.

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ mogelijkheid tot bijkopen) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.

  • Een afwisselende leidinggevende functie binnen een internationale organisatie die volop groeit.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting logistiek of transport.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een logistieke of operationele omgeving.

  • Ervaring met het aansturen, coachen of begeleiden van medewerkers.

  • Bereidheid om in ploegendiensten en incidenteel op zaterdag te werken.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Engels is een pré.

  • Ervaring met LEAN of procesverbetering is een pré.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht, besluitvaardig en behoudt overzicht onder druk.

  • Je hebt oog voor veiligheid en kwaliteit.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega's die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer direct bij DPD door op de rode knop 'solliciteren' te klikken. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je eerst vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze Corporate Recruiter Jordi Ernest via +31 6 29 10 50 26.

Klik hier voor meer informatie over ons sollicitatieproces.

Acquisitie en doorplaatsing van deze vacature worden niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Als Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung arbeitest du in unserem neuen Fulfilment Center im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) mit hochautomatisierten Intralogistiksystemen von Top-Marken wie Apollo, Qimarox und Regal Rexnord. Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung während deiner Schicht und führst unser Team aus Maintenance Technicians.

Du setzt Prioritäten, sorgst für eine sichere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Maintenance und Operations. Bei kritischen Störungen übernimmst du die Führung und stellst gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Anlagen schnell wieder laufen.

Deine Führungskompetenz, dein technisches Verständnis und deine Hands-on-Mentalität sind gefragt, damit täglich rund 10.000 Bestellungen pünktlich bei unseren Kund:innen ankommen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Führe & entwickle dein Team: Du führst die Maintenance Technicians während deiner Schicht, coachst sie im Arbeitsalltag und unterstützt ihre Entwicklung.
  • Steuere die Schicht: Du setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst die Maintenance-Aktivitäten und stellst eine hohe Qualität und Anlagenverfügbarkeit sicher.
  • Manage kritische Störungen: Du koordinierst dein Team bei technischen Problemen und arbeitest eng mit Operations zusammen, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren.
  • Sorge für Sicherheit & Struktur: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Sicherheitsstandards sowie eine saubere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise eingehalten werden.
  • Treibe Verbesserungen voran: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt Lean-, 5S- und Continuous-Improvement-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit deinem Team um.
  • Arbeite übergreifend zusammen: Du stimmst dich eng mit Operations, Maintenance Engineers und externen Maintenance-Partnern ab.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister oder ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor/Master), z. B. in Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
  • Du bringst 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem technischen oder Instandhaltungsumfeld mit, idealerweise in einer automatisierten, logistischen oder produzierenden Umgebung
  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung, z. B. als Team Lead, Lead Technician, Supervisor oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Du hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität und verstehst sowohl die technische als auch die operative Seite von Maintenance
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Lean, 5S und Continuous Improvement und setzt diese Prinzipien gerne praktisch auf der Fläche um
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und behältst auch bei kritischen Störungen den Überblick
  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus)

Darauf kannst du dich freuen 

  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche im Schichtsystem) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei - durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.

title: Teamleiter Fulfillment (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Knuspr definieren wir den Lebensmitteleinkauf neu. Um täglich Tausende Kunden zuverlässig mit frischen, regionalen Lebensmitteln und Artikeln des täglichen Bedarfs zu beliefern, braucht es ein hocheffizientes operatives Rückgrat.

Als Central Flow Lead bist du die zentrale Steuerungsinstanz für den Personaleinsatz und den operativen Durchfluss in unseren deutschen Fulfillment Centern. Von deinem Büroarbeitsplatz in Garching überwachst du die operative Leistung in Echtzeit, steuerst die Personalkapazitäten dynamisch und stimmst dich direkt mit den Teams vor Ort ab, um jeden Standort auf maximaler Effizienz zu halten.

Deine Mission ist direkt: Live-Daten in unmittelbare Handlungen übersetzen. Indem du Engpässe frühzeitig erkennst, Personal bedarfsgerecht zwischen den Bereichen ausbalancierst und die Abläufe synchronisierst, stellst du sicher, dass jede Bestellung reibungslos bearbeitet und pünktlich ausgeliefert wird.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist:

  • Büroarbeitsplatz: Du arbeitest ausschließlich im Control Office in Garching, ohne körperliche Lagertätigkeit, und steuerst die Abläufe vom Schreibtisch aus über Dashboards und Steuerungstools

  • Einfluss auf nationaler Ebene: Steuere die Personaleinsatzplanung und den operativen Durchsatz mehrerer deutscher Fulfillment Center

  • Echtzeit-Entscheidungen: Arbeite in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld, in dem Live-Daten unmittelbar zu spürbaren operativen Anpassungen führen

  • Intelligente Logistik & Technologie: Gestalte die Schnittstelle zwischen Lagerautomatisierung, WMS-Plattformen und datengestützter Personalsteuerung aktiv mit

Was wir zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt bieten:

  • Tägliche Essenspauschale: Zusätzliche 9,00 € steuerfreier Essenszuschuss pro Arbeitstag

  • Täglicher Fahrtkostenzuschuss: Zusätzliche 5,00 € täglicher Zuschuss zu deinen Fahrtkosten

  • Halbjährliche Gutscheine: 300,00 € in Gutscheinen zweimal jährlich (insgesamt 600,00 € pro Jahr)

  • Knuspr Xtra Account: 10 % Cashback auf deine Bestellungen direkt als Knuspr-Guthaben

  • CorporateBenefits: Vergünstigungen auf Fitness, Reisen, Event-Tickets, Shopping und mehr

Deine Aufgaben

  • Abläufe im Blick behalten: Du verfolgst unsere Dashboards in Echtzeit und sorgst dafür, dass die richtigen Kollegen/-innen zur richtigen Zeit im richtigen Bereich sind. Dafür nutzt du unsere zentralen Steuerungstools

  • Kapazitäten flexibel ausbalancieren: Wenn sich das Auftragsvolumen oder die Prioritäten an einem Standort ändern, passt du Personalverteilung und Schichtpläne entsprechend an

  • Operative Kennzahlen aktiv steuern: Du hast kritische Bereitstellungszeiten und Leerläufe fest im Blick, deckst Engpässe sofort auf und greifst korrigierend ein

  • Standortübergreifend zusammenarbeiten: Du stimmst dich eng mit den Führungskräften und Teams auf der Fläche ab, damit Anpassungen gut umgesetzt werden und unsere Prozessstandards eingehalten werden

  • Gemeinsam besser werden: Du analysierst Schichtleistungen, entdeckst wiederkehrende Prozesslücken, überprüfst gemeinsam mit den Standorten unsere SOP-Standards und hilfst mit deinem Feedback, unsere internen Tools weiterzuentwickeln

Was du mitbringst:

  • Operativer Hintergrund: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Speditionskaufmann/-frau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, wie z.B. praktische Erfahrung als Disponent, in der Schichtkoordination, operativen Einsatzplanung oder Personaleinsatzsteuerung, idealerweise in Logistik, Lager, Einzelhandel, E-Commerce oder Fulfillment.

  • Erfahrung in einem Leitstand, Control Center oder Control Tower, im Workforce Management oder mit automatisierten Lägern ist ein Plus.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die tägliche Kommunikation. Gute Ungarischkenntnisse für die klare Abstimmung mit den Teams auf der Fläche sind ein großer Vorteil

  • Schichtbereitschaft: Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem 24-Stunden-Dreischichtsystem von Montag bis Samstag

  • Operativer Weitblick: Du behältst komplexe Abläufe souverän im Blick, verknüpfst operative Schnittstellen und steuerst Maßnahmen standortübergreifend und zielgerichtet.

  • Analytische Schärfe: Du verstehst KPIs, SLAs, Workflow-Steuerung sowie Personaleinsatzplanung – und triffst auch unter Druck sichere, datenbasierte Entscheidungen

  • Technologiekompetenz: Du arbeitest sicher mit Echtzeit-Dashboards, WMS-Plattformen und Tools zur automatisierten Steuerung des Arbeitskräfteflusses

  • La veille sur les évolutions du SEO, du GEO et des nouveaux usages de recherche

---

Mesure et pilotage de la performance :

Vous mettez en place les outils nécessaires pour mesurer précisément les résultats obtenus.

Vous êtes capable de répondre à des questions simples mais essentielles :

  • Quel est le coût par lead ou par acquisition ?
  • Quel est le retour sur investissement ?
  • Que faut-il arrêter, maintenir, tester ou intensifier ?

Vous construisez des tableaux de bord, analysez les KPI et produisez des comptes rendus clairs et exploitables pour les clients.

Conseil et relation client

Vous participez aux réunions de suivi avec les clients.

Vous présentez les résultats obtenus, expliquez les écarts, recommandez les prochaines actions et êtes force de proposition.

Vous savez transformer des données parfois complexes en conclusions compréhensibles et en décisions concrètes.

Les outils à maîtriser idéalement :

Vous devez être opérationnel sur une grande partie des outils suivants :

  • Looker Studio
  • Semrush
  • Ahrefs
  • Screaming Frog
  • WordPress
  • Meta Business Manager
  • LinkedIn Campaign Manager
  • Microsoft Advertising

La maîtrise de l’intelligence artificielle est obligatoire. Vous utilisez avec discernement ChatGPT, Claude ou d’autres solutions selon les besoins : recherche, analyse, rédaction, automatisation, idéation, audit et optimisation.

Nous ne recherchons pas quelqu’un qui confie sa réflexion à l’IA, mais une personne capable de l’utiliser pour travailler plus vite, approfondir ses analyses et améliorer la qualité de ses productions.

Vos compétences

Le profil recherché

Vous justifiez d’au moins trois ans d’expérience sur un poste en acquisition digitale, traffic management, SEO, SEA ou performance marketing. Une expérience de trois à cinq ans, idéalement en agence ou auprès de plusieurs clients, est attendue.

Vous êtes :

Vous n’avez pas besoin de maîtriser parfaitement toutes les plateformes dès votre arrivée. En revanche, vous devez disposer de bases solides en Google Ads, SEO, analytics et tracking, ainsi que d’une réelle capacité à apprendre et à expérimenter.

---

La veille fait partie du poste

Chez Size Up, la veille n’est pas une activité occasionnelle réalisée en dehors du temps de travail.

Elle fait pleinement partie des missions et peut être réalisée pendant les heures de travail. Nous attendons de la personne recrutée qu’elle explore les nouveaux outils, teste de nouvelles méthodes, suive les évolutions des plateformes et partage ses découvertes avec l’équipe.

title: Venture Scout (Remote in Europe)
descriptionHtml:
About First Momentum Ventures

We're building one of Europe's most distinctive early-stage venture funds. As students, we've deployed two funds (now totaling €35m) into ~50 pre-seed Deep Tech companies across Europe. Our portfolio has raised follow-on funding from top-tier European and US investors.

Today, we're a community of over 100 (mostly technical) scouts, founders, and operators who help us identify the best technical founders before anyone else does. We accept only 1 in 15 applicants; this isn't just another community. We operate under clear rules that ensure everyone is committed, and we kindly offboard those here only for the VC tag.

Note: This is an unpaid role with performance-based referral bounties for successful investments.

Tasks

What You'll Do

Source breakthrough companies. Connect us to the most promising technical founders in your ecosystem, people building in labs, at hackathons, in research groups, or launching their first startup.

Represent us locally. Attend events, universities, and accelerators where technical founders gather. Make it easy for them to find us.

Share your expertise. When we evaluate companies in your domain, semicon, robotics, climate tech, AI infrastructure, we'll tap your technical knowledge and ecosystem insights.

Contribute to portfolio success. Our scouts don't just source deals. They actively support our portfolio companies through introductions, domain expertise, and ecosystem connections.

Shape our strategy. Help us understand your local scene: which research is commercializing, which founders are worth watching, which technologies are gaining momentum.

Requirements

Who Thrives in This Role

You're technically fluent, whether as a CS/engineering student, PhD researcher, startup operator, or technical founder. You can have credible conversations with deeply technical people.

You're embedded in a European tech ecosystem, connected to a university, research institution, or startup community. You know who's building what.

You're genuinely curious about Deep Tech or industrial innovation. You follow research, products, and companies in areas such as TechBio, Energy, Manufacturing, and developer tools.

You're entrepreneurial and self-directed. You create opportunities, follow through, and take ownership of your impact.

You want to learn how early-stage investing works, and you're willing to put in the work.

Benefits

What You'll Gain

Real VC experience. See how deals happen from sourcing through investment decisions. Join workshops on term sheets, technical diligence, and portfolio support.

A powerful network. Build relationships with founders, investors, and fellow scouts across Europe that compound over time.

Domain expertise. Go deep on emerging technologies through deal reviews and virtual sessions.

Career acceleration. Many scouts join startups, launch companies, or build VC careers. This role opens doors.

Community access. Join a European community of technical builders and attend startup events where the most interesting work happens.

Chapter Lead Opportunities

High-performing scouts can grow into Chapter Lead roles at their university or city. Chapter Leads take on additional responsibility:

  • Recruit strategically. Build a scout presence across relevant faculties and fill gaps when scouts move on
  • Foster community. Organize one meetup per quarter to keep your local scout network engaged
  • Support events. Work with the First Momentum team to bring startup events to your ecosystem

title: Workforce & Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.
